notes.title: Hats? Hats!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Nobody asked for it, but hats have been added to the game! Applying a hat will apply it to all store employees of your store.
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Fixes & More Disguises!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that was causing players to not be able to use the toilet in the jail.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused players to become criminals when using another store's toilet. 
[*] Added more random disguises.
[*] Added random 3d models around town to help hide when disguised.
[*] Fixed a bug that was causing trash dropped by customers to stack incorrectly on top of each other.
[/list]

notes.title: Bug fixes & Disguises!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Patched bug fixes from main version that help with quality of life and issues that affected the game previously.
[*] Disguises and push to talk inputs have been added to the HUD!
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Fixes and Optomizations!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added bug fixes and optimizations from main game!
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Patch v011
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that was causing the ordering terminal menu's to be offset incorrectly for some translations. 

[*] Fixed a few incorrect translations reported to us by players.
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Patch v010
notes.content: We have re-written some of the checkout code to help resolve reports of some clients having their register become unusable unless they rejoin the game. Please alert us if you notice this issue still occuring.

notes.title: Bug Patch v009 & Re: New NPCs
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added additional code to catch exceptions where customers are becoming stuck for some players. Please notify us if this is still occuring for you.
[*] Dumpsters will now allow trash to be tossed into them, similar to the garbage cans. 
[*] Changed the trash can model to a smaller size.
[*] New NPC character models have been re-enabled. We believe we have successfully fixed the bug that was causing them to crash.
[/list]

notes.title: Crash Bug Fix & Character Update Reversal
notes.content: We were made aware of certain computers crashing due to the new character models that were introduced to the game. We have reverted the NPCs back to the old models until we can confirm the bug has been resolved.

notes.title: Bug Patch 008 & New NPC Characters
notes.content:
Fixed a bug that would cause the terminal paint settings interface to be stuck on screen if escape was pressed to exit.

Added new character models for NPCs. Currently there is a small visual latency when the first customer is spawned. We are working to resolve this issue. New player character models are also being worked on.

notes.title: Customer NPC Feedback Patch
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Previously, customers would not show up to a store if the price for the item they wanted was too high. We have now implemented a system where the customer will walk into the store and display a UI above their head, showing that the item was too high priced for them, before leaving. We will continue to update this system as we garner feedback from testing. 
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Patch 007 & Features
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with customers not being able to navigate stores with moved furniture.
[*] Players can no longer block the entrance of the store with shelves.
[*] Stores can now be password protected from the computer terminal! Players who attempt to join the store will be prompted for the password.
[/list]

notes.title: Bug patch v006 & Features
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that would cause replicated furniture on load.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused some sessions to load incorrectly if the game wasn't exited between sessions.
[*] Fixed an issue with products being stealable in multiplayer if the ordered stack of products was too high.
[*] Fixed a bug that would cause pop up icons to show when other stores closed a cash drawer or picked up a trash bag.

[*] Changed how music is played in stores so that position in store shouldn't matter.
[*] Added a field of view slider to the options menu.
[*] Added an add and subtract button to cart items in the ordering terminal. 
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Patch v005
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added extra code to help catch any possible issues with end of day causing the cash drawer to get stuck open.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused exact change to not be accepted unless at least a cent over was given. This did not affect all transactions.
[*] Fixed an issue that would sometimes cause price tags to load with 0.00 as the price until adjusted.
[*] Fixed an issue with multiple shelves not selling products. 
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Patch v004
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Raised market price 5% to improve default profit on products.
[*] Added a slider in the options menu for increasing or decreasing the crosshair size.
[*] Fixed translation issues with the furniture, tool, and license names in the ordering terminal.
[*] Scroll wheel to rotate furniture will now properly show when placing furniture. 
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Patch v003
notes.content: Resolved an issue that was causing some players to start the match without being able to remove the tutorial widget.

notes.title: Bug Patch v002!
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug that caused the server and client to see different items on shelves. 
- Opposing store players can no longer turn on other store's power, only off. This was enacted to reduce notification spamming by opposing players.
- Resolved an issue that was causing price tags to round to the nearest dollar in certain languages.

notes.title: Bug Fixes!
notes.content:
- Resolved a bug that caused some languages to change prices of items to 100x their set values. This seemed to only occur in languages that used commas where English uses periods.
- Added the ability to press "Escape" in the tutorial menus to avoid the possibility of the UI being stuck on screen.
- UI improvements to account for foreign language spacing.
